svg.title: Follow a line: twelve studies
svg.desc: An illustrated sheet of Aldebaran’s twelve orbital studies, in reading order. Each picture links to its study. The small previews use numerical geometry; some graphs use different axes or scales.
svg.text: Circles, crossings, and the small spaces between. Choose a picture to explore.

a.aria-label: Study 002: The birth of a loop
Study 003: A region can count backwards
Study 004: Two lobes, two ways to turn
a.text: Two lobes, two ways to turn

Study 007: A small turn breaks the mirror
Study 008: One cubic, two area laws
Study 010: The same counts, a different weave
